collections.title: AI governance and institutional accountability
collections.description: Reviews examining how AI systems redistribute authority, create institutional duties and expose gaps between governance principles and enforceable controls.

collections.title: Digital identity and trust infrastructure
collections.description: Work on identity, credentials, trust registries, assurance and the institutional mechanisms that make claims actionable across organisational boundaries.

collections.title: Digital public infrastructure and state capacity
collections.description: Reviews connecting public digital rails to sovereignty, administrative capability, inclusion, procurement and the long-term control of essential infrastructure.

collections.title: Agent authority, delegation and redress
collections.description: Papers concerned with who may act, how machine authority is bounded, what evidence proves mandate and how affected parties challenge or reverse consequential actions.

collections.title: Epistemic integrity and human capability
collections.description: Research on deskilling, dependency, scientific reliability, language access and the institutional conditions required to preserve human judgement under automation.

collections.title: Governance beyond principles
collections.description: Reviews that test whether governance claims are operational: whether authority, evidence, enforcement, revocation, accountability and remedy are actually implemented.
